module: Editor window "CameraProfiler" (Debug > Performance Recorder menu) to record and compare performance. It starts a recording along a camera path (*.camPath.json from the levels/<level>/perfRecordingCampaths/ folder) via test_util_fpsCamRecorder and util_stepHandler, loads .perfRecording.json files, plots curves (fps_average, fps_min, polyCount, drawCalls, memory...) in "Profiler Chart N" windows (10 max) and compares the files in a table. Useful to measure the impact of a mod or a graphics setting.
notes: Plottable data keys: fps_instant, fps_average, fps_min, fps_max, fps_waitForGPU, gfx_polyCount, gfx_drawCalls, mem_osPhys*/mem_osVirt*, mem_processPhysUsed/VirtUsed.
Load files: filter ".perfRecording.json", folder /perfRecordings/. An optional annotation file is searched in /levels/<lvl>/perfRecordingCampaths/<name>.perfAnnotation.json.

Probable bug: in loadFile, the line "metadataFile = file" uses a variable "file" never defined in the function (nil); the metadata window therefore does not open after a load. Also, globalNames receives file.name, a field that loadFile does not set (only file.meta.name).
The "Delete All Vehicles" button of the recording popup really deletes all the vehicles.

loadFile.desc: Loads a JSON performance file (jsonReadFile), completes meta.name (file name), looks for a level annotation file, converts each sample to pos=vec3 and rot=quat, marks the file active and adds it to the list of compared files. Does nothing if filepath is empty.

data.desc: Return table of the file dialog; only data.filepath (path of the .perfRecording.json) is read.

onEditorGui.desc: Called every frame by the editor. Draws the main window (Record / Load / New Chart Window menu, file table with checkbox, color, name), recomputes colors and charts if needed, then the charts, the comparison table, the metadata window and the recording popup.

dt.desc: Delta time passed to the charts.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Registers the CameraProfiler window (500x500) and the "Performance Recorder" menu entry (Debug group).
